status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Add formulas from the provided L3T Google Sheet to matching 1L3T JSON cases as the first algorithm, preserving existing algorithms and avoiding duplicate entries.
assumptions: Match sheet rows to JSON cases by group + case, e.g. V + s+ matches case name Vs+.
Use the sheet Algorithm column as the new algorithm text.
Do not modify scrambles, setup values, SVGs, groups, metadata, or app bundle output.

tasks.title: Prepare sheet and JSON comparison
tasks.summary: Fetch and parse sheet rows, then confirm all sheet case keys exist in JSON.
verify: No sheet case key is missing from JSON.

tasks.title: Insert sheet algorithms first
tasks.targets: Matched JSON cases from the sheet
tasks.summary: For each matched sheet row, add or move the sheet Algorithm value to algorithms[0].
verify: All non-empty sheet algorithms are at algorithms[0].
Existing algorithms remain present unless they were duplicate values.

tasks.title: Validate changed JSON
tasks.summary: Parse JSON and confirm expected counts and protected-field stability.

tasks.title: Finalize checklist
tasks.summary: Mark verified tasks complete and archive the checklist with a matching filename count.
verify: Filename count matches completed task count.
